comment: Examine text for world objects, by their key. Items keep theirs in items.json.

objects.tree_stump: Someone's been chopping here. It'll grow back.
objects.dead_tree: Grey and leafless. The ash killed it long ago, but the wood is still good.
objects.dead_tree_stump: All that's left of a dead tree.
objects.tin_rock: A rock with flecks of tin.
objects.iron_rock: Rust-red veins of iron run through this rock.
objects.anvil: Heavy, scarred iron. Used for smithing.
objects.bank_booth: The clerk keeps the town's valuables safe.
objects.market_stall: A trader's stall, piled with wares.
objects.altar: A quiet altar to the Dawn.
objects.statue: A weathered statue of some old hero of Kelmoor.
objects.standing_stone: An ancient stone. It hums faintly when you touch it.
objects.log_pile: Neatly stacked logs, ready for the yard.
objects.hide_tent: A tent of stitched hides. It smells of smoke.
objects.goblin_totem: A crude totem hung with bones and feathers.
objects.copper_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.

objects.coal_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.furnace: A roaring furnace. Hot enough to smelt ore into bars.
objects.range: A big iron cooking range. Something smells good.
objects.shallow_fishing_spot: Little fish are darting about in the shallows.
objects.deep_fishing_spot: Something big is moving down there.
objects.shopkeeper: Runs the General Store. Knows the price of everything.
objects.aldric: A broad-shouldered bladesmith with scarred forearms.
objects.cook_tobin: The Blue Gull's cook. His apron has seen things.
objects.banker: Keeps Kelmoor's valuables safe and its ledgers neat.
